review: triage: rules/triage/701.62.jsonl was missing, so validate never checked this file; wrote it.

scenarios.title: Manifest dread manifests one of the top two cards and mills the other
decisions: A casts Break Down the Door choosing the manifest dread mode, tapping the three Forests.
Both players pass; the spell resolves.
A looks at the top two cards, manifests Grizzly Bears and puts Forest into the graveyard.

variants.label: base
variants.expected: Grizzly Bears enters the battlefield face down as a 2/2 creature under A's control, Forest moves from the library to A's graveyard, and Mountain stays as the top card of the library.

variants.label: one_card_library
variants.delta: A's library holds only Grizzly Bears.
variants.expected: Grizzly Bears enters the battlefield face down as a 2/2 creature. Nothing is put into the graveyard and the library is empty.

operation.unclassifiable: not a board edit: two cards leave A's library and go to no zone

variants.label: empty_library
variants.expected: No card is manifested and none is put into the graveyard; the spell resolves and A has no new creature.

operation.unclassifiable: not a board edit: three cards leave A's library and go to no zone

scenarios.forge_notes: The face-down creature can be turned up for its mana cost if it is a creature card; that is not exercised here.

detector.outcome: A manifest dread resolution puts the looked-at card it did not manifest from the library into the graveyard.
detector.near_miss: A manifest dread resolution that puts no card from the library into the graveyard, because the library held fewer than two cards.

scenarios.title: Manifest dread triggers after the process, even when parts were impossible

setup.notes: Libraries are listed top first. Paranormal Analyst is not summoning sick and is A's.

decisions: A casts Break Down the Door choosing the manifest dread mode, tapping the three Forests.
Both players pass; the spell resolves.
A manifests Grizzly Bears and puts Forest into the graveyard.
Paranormal Analyst's trigger resolves and A returns the Forest from the graveyard to hand.

variants.label: base
variants.expected: Paranormal Analyst's trigger fires after the manifest dread completes. Grizzly Bears is a face-down 2/2 under A's control and Forest moves from A's graveyard to A's hand.

variants.label: one_card_library
variants.delta: A's library holds only Grizzly Bears.
variants.expected: Paranormal Analyst's trigger still fires, although no card was put into the graveyard. Grizzly Bears is a face-down 2/2 under A's control, nothing moves to A's hand and the library is empty.

operation.unclassifiable: not a board edit: two cards leave A's library and go to no zone

variants.label: opponent_manifests
variants.delta: A does not cast Break Down the Door; A passes priority and B casts B's own Break Down the Door choosing manifest dread, manifesting Grizzly Bears and putting Forest into B's graveyard.
variants.expected: Paranormal Analyst's trigger does not fire, because only A manifesting dread triggers it. B has a face-down 2/2 and Forest in B's graveyard; A's hand and graveyard are unchanged.

operation.unclassifiable: choice: A casts nothing and B casts Break Down the Door instead

scenarios.forge_notes: Forge's ManifestDread trigger is TriggerManifestDread. B's cards are used only in the opponent_manifests variant.

detector.outcome: A trigger on manifesting dread is evaluated and fires after the process.
detector.near_miss: The trigger is evaluated for another player's manifest dread and does not fire.
